name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Delgren sends you north to meet Balthule Shadowstrike before the assault on Athrikus Narassin. The scout has watched the Tower of Althalaxx and can report what has changed there.

sections.title: A Scout's Report
sections.body: Delgren the Purifier sends you north to speak with Balthule Shadowstrike, his sentinel partner. You have purified corrupted relics and weakened the cult's hold along Darkshore's border. Before you confront the sorcerer Athrikus, Delgren wants fresh intelligence from Balthule, who has kept watch from the ruins overlooking the tower.

sections.title: Disturbances in the Spire
sections.body: Balthule Shadowstrike reports strange disturbances in the tower's upper sanctum. Blinding flashes, agonizing screams, and erratic lightning now shake the ancient elven spire. What is happening inside threatens to make the approach to Athrikus more dangerous.

faq.q: Why does Delgren send me back to Balthule?
faq.answer: Delgren sends you to Balthule because he wants fresh information before you confront Athrikus. Balthule has watched the Tower of Althalaxx and can report what he has seen there.
Balthule Shadowstrike keeps an observation campsite on the hills just west of the Tower of Althalaxx, watching the ruins in northern Darkshore.

faq.q: What recent events did Balthule witness at the tower?
faq.answer: Balthule saw a blinding flash from the tower's highest chamber, then heard wretched screams carry across the coast and saw erratic lightning bolts strike the ground.
Athrikus Narassin is the dark sorcerer leading the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. Delgren and Balthule are determined to stop his fell rituals.

faq.q: Is Delgren the Purifier a local night elf?
faq.answer: No. Delgren is a human paladin and warrior of the Holy Light, stationed on the border between Darkshore and Ashenvale. He has joined night elf scouts to purge demonic corruption.

faq.q: What kind of ruin is the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: The Tower of Althalaxx is an ancient night elf spire along Darkshore's craggy northern cliffs. It was abandoned before fallen arcanists and demonic cultists claimed it for forbidden rites.

angles.text: Delgren and Balthule work together to protect northern Kalimdor, joining human paladins with night elf scouts.
Delgren studies the danger before acting, showing the discipline expected of a warrior of the Light.
Balthule Shadowstrike defends ancestral lands from sorcery like the reckless arcane excesses that ruined night elf civilization ten millennia ago.
